workspace.stale: Results are out of date. The dataset, model or analysis options have changed. Run the analysis again.
workspace.annotationFailed: Estimate labels could not be arranged at the saved positions. Reflow the diagram or use values only.

data.title: Start with your data.
data.subtitle: Import a file or try a public example. Your dataset stays on this device.
data.loadedHint: Inspect cases, variable types and missing values before fitting your model.
data.formats: CSV, TSV, Excel (.xlsx / .xls) or SPSS (.sav / .zsav) · up to 50 MB
data.missingHint: Comma-separated. Empty cells are missing. SPSS uses its file definitions.
data.exampleHint: Load a dataset and its matching model, then run the analysis.
data.exampleSource: First two datasets: lavaan package. Mediation: deterministic synthetic data.
data.matrixHint: Paste CSV with variable names in the first row, then a full square sample covariance matrix (divisor N−1). Omit row labels. Variable order must match optional means. lavaan applies its ML rescaling.
data.matrixCases: Sample statistics for N = {n}. This matrix does not contain individual cases.
data.selectVariable: Select a column to inspect its variable details.
data.orderedHint: Ascending stored values define the ordinal order. Recode in the source file if another order is needed.
data.typeHint: Type changes affect the analysis, mark results out of date and leave stored values unchanged.

results.title: Results follow your model.
results.empty: Attach a dataset, specify a valid model and run the analysis to see estimates and fit measures.
results.inadmissible: The solution has inadmissible estimates. Inspect lavaan's warnings; diagram estimates are unavailable.
results.zeroDf: This model has zero degrees of freedom. Global fit cannot test it against the data; CFI = 1 or RMSEA = 0 does not establish good fit.
results.failed: The analysis could not be completed. Previous results, if any, are retained below.
results.notAvailable: Not available for this estimator or model.
results.precision: Display and APA tables use three decimals; CSV and JSON retain full numerical precision.
results.robustHint: Scaled and robust statistics are labelled explicitly. Compare the appropriate version for your estimator.

advanced.optionsHint: Select the output you need, then run the analysis. Reliability and validity require a simple CFA with at least two indicators per factor.
advanced.invarianceHint: Use continuous indicators, CFA, two or more groups and an unconstrained model without parameter labels. The mean structure is enabled for this sequence.
advanced.bootstrapHint: ML with raw data; percentile intervals. The saved seed makes resampling reproducible. Cancel stops the R worker and keeps your dataset.
advanced.invarianceNote: Each stage is compared with the previous stage using lavaan's difference test. ΔCFI and ΔRMSEA are signed changes; the exact fit-index variants are reported. These statistics do not automatically establish invariance.
advanced.modificationNote: Modification indices concern fixed-to-zero parameters, not equality constraints. Add a theoretically justified parameter, then rerun the model. An addition applies only to the indicated group.
advanced.reliabilityNote: Unit-weight omega-type composite reliability and AVE use observed variances (semTools). HTMT2 uses absolute correlations and geometric means; ordinal indicators use polychoric correlations. Reverse-code items in the source data when appropriate.
advanced.fornellNote: Fornell–Larcker compares each factor's square root of AVE with the absolute fitted latent correlation. “Yes” means both square roots exceed that correlation; it is not a general validity verdict.
advanced.simpleCfa: Available for a simple CFA with at least two indicators per factor, no cross-loadings, higher-order factors, formative relations or structural regressions.
advanced.inadmissible: Unavailable because the fitted solution did not converge or is inadmissible.
advanced.unavailable: This calculation was unavailable for this fitted model.
advanced.notRequested: Select this output under Analysis options and run the analysis.
advanced.truncated: The first 5,000 modification indices are retained, sorted by MI.
advanced.bootstrapNote: Percentile confidence intervals are unstandardised. SEs are bootstrap SEs; z and p remain normal approximations. lavaan excludes failed draws from the intervals and reports inadmissible draws separately.
advanced.reportNote: Estimates and intervals are unstandardised; Std. all is fully standardised. Values are rounded only for display. A dash indicates unavailable output.
advanced.staleReport: The model, data or options have changed since these results were computed.
advanced.exportHint: The full diagram is exported with the current annotations, theme and implicit-parameter visibility. PNG uses the print width and DPI; PDF uses the print width and preserves vectors.
advanced.printSize: At this print width, parameter labels are approximately {size} pt. Increase the width for dense models.
advanced.exportFailed: The export could not be created. Try a smaller print size or another format.
advanced.starsNote: * p < .05, ** p < .01, *** p < .001. Fixed paths receive no stars.
advanced.verifying: Checking public and synthetic fixtures. Keep this page open; your dataset will be restored.

errors.project.badFit: The project contains invalid saved analysis results. Restore a valid project copy.
errors.project.tooLarge: This project exceeds 100 MB. Save it without the dataset, and retain the original data file separately.
errors.engine.missing: The local statistics engine is incomplete. Use the complete Forma distribution and reload.
errors.engine.integrity: The statistics engine failed its integrity check. Restore the complete Forma distribution and reload.
errors.advanced.bootstrapCount: Choose 100–10,000 bootstrap resamples, or turn bootstrap off.
errors.advanced.seed: Choose an integer random seed from 1 to 2,147,483,647.
errors.advanced.miConstraint: This fixed parameter shares a label with other parameters. Edit its constraints in syntax before freeing it.
errors.advanced.confidence: Choose a confidence level between 80% and 99%.
errors.advanced.bootstrapEstimator: Bootstrap requires ML and raw data. The estimator has not been changed.
errors.advanced.separate: Run bootstrap and measurement invariance separately.
errors.advanced.invarianceCfa: Invariance requires a CFA preset, raw data, and at least two groups.
errors.advanced.invarianceOrdinal: The automated invariance sequence currently supports continuous indicators with ML/MLR. Ordinal invariance needs additional identification constraints; specify those models separately in syntax.
errors.advanced.invarianceSyntax: Use an unconstrained simple CFA without parameter labels or explicit constraints for the automated invariance sequence.
errors.advanced.invarianceMeans: Enable the mean structure before running measurement invariance.
errors.advanced.invarianceScaling: The automated sequence uses first-loading marker scaling. Use a first loading fixed to 1, other loadings free, and free factor/residual variances without explicit means. Specify other identification schemes in syntax.
errors.advanced.semTools: Reliability requires the semTools package. Retry after its download finishes.
errors.advanced.semToolsVersion: This build requires semTools 0.5-10. The package repository supplied a different version.
errors.layout.feedback: Feedback cycles need a dedicated layout and are not supported in this version.
errors.layout.route: A covariance could not be routed without crossing a variable. Try reflowing the diagram.
errors.layout.labels: Labels could not be placed with enough clearance. Try shorter display names or reflow the diagram.
errors.layout.nodes: There is not enough space to preserve the saved positions. Reflow the diagram or move the affected variables.
errors.model.empty: Enter a lavaan model to create a diagram.
errors.model.pathLatent: Path analysis uses observed variables only. Remove latent or composite definitions, or choose SEM or CFA.
errors.model.multilevel: Multilevel diagrams are not supported in this version.
errors.model.efa: Exploratory factor blocks are not supported in this version.
errors.model.large: This version supports diagrams with up to 300 variables.
errors.data.none: Import a dataset before running an analysis.
errors.data.changed: The dataset changed. Refresh the data view or run the analysis again.
errors.data.size: This version supports up to 200,000 cases, 500 variables and five million cells per dataset.
errors.data.fileSize: Choose a dataset file of 50 MB or less.
errors.data.names: Variable names must be nonempty and unique. Correct the names in the source file and import it again.
errors.data.nested: Nested/list columns are unsupported. Supply one value per cell.
errors.data.nonfinite: The file contains infinite numeric values. Replace them with valid or missing values before importing.
errors.data.format: Choose CSV, TSV, Excel (.xls/.xlsx) or SPSS (.sav/.zsav).
errors.data.matrix: Supply a full square numeric covariance matrix with a header row of unique variable names.
errors.data.matrixPositive: The covariance matrix must be symmetric and positive definite.
errors.data.sampleSize: Supply an integer sample size of at least two.
errors.data.means: Supply one finite mean per variable, in the matrix's variable order.
errors.data.type: Choose a valid variable and measurement type.
errors.data.numeric: Continuous variables must contain numeric stored values. Recode the source file before importing.
errors.data.levels: Ordinal variables may have up to 100 distinct categories in this version.
errors.data.columns: Request fewer columns in the data view.
errors.analysis.options: Choose a supported estimator and missing-data method.
errors.analysis.ordinalFiml: WLSMV does not support FIML. Choose listwise deletion or pairwise handling.
errors.analysis.pairwise: Pairwise handling is available with WLSMV. Use listwise deletion or FIML with ML/MLR.
errors.analysis.absent: Model variables missing from the dataset
errors.analysis.nonnumeric: Recode this nominal/text variable or select its intended numeric measurement type
errors.analysis.orderedEstimator: Ordinal model variables require WLSMV. The selected estimator has not been changed.
errors.analysis.group: Choose a grouping variable for this multigroup model.
errors.analysis.groupCount: The number of nonmissing grouping-variable values must match the model's group count.
errors.analysis.matrixGroups: This version supports one group per covariance-matrix input.
errors.analysis.matrixEstimator: Covariance input currently supports ML with listwise handling. Robust estimators require additional sample information.
errors.analysis.matrixMeans: This model requires a mean structure. Supply the sample means with the covariance matrix.
errors.edit.blocks: Visual editing of separate group/level syntax blocks is not supported yet. Keep editing this model in the syntax pane.
errors.edit.modifier: This model contains a modifier that cannot be preserved by the visual editor. Use the syntax pane.
errors.edit.positional: Use named parameter labels instead of positional references or equal() references before editing this model visually.
errors.edit.roundtrip: The model could not be regenerated without changing its parameter table. The edit was not applied.
errors.edit.name: Enter a valid lavaan variable name of up to 100 characters.
errors.edit.duplicate: A variable with that name already exists.
errors.edit.expression: A definition or constraint could not be preserved. Edit it in the syntax pane.
errors.edit.dependencies: This change would leave a definition or constraint referring to a missing parameter label. Update that expression in the syntax pane first.
errors.edit.endpoints: Choose two different variables already in the model.
errors.edit.loadingSource: Choose a latent variable as the source of a loading.
errors.edit.formativeTarget: Choose a latent/composite variable as the target of a formative arrow.
errors.edit.exists: That relation already exists. Select its path or parameter to edit it.
errors.edit.implicitExists: That covariance is already added by the preset. Turn on implicit parameters and select the existing arc to edit it.
errors.edit.fixedX: These exogenous variances/covariances are supplied by the data under fixed_x. Turn off fixed exogenous variables before overriding them.
errors.edit.ambiguous: This parameter has multiple source declarations. Edit it in the syntax pane.
errors.edit.defaultGroups: Apply to all groups to restore automatic fixation, or set an explicit value for the selected group.
errors.edit.value: Enter a finite numeric fixed value.
errors.edit.label: Enter a parameter label of up to 100 characters without line breaks.
errors.edit.variable: Select a variable already in the model.
errors.edit.verification: The requested parameter change could not be verified by lavaan. The edit was not applied.
errors.badDatasetAttachment: The project contains an invalid or unsupported dataset attachment.
errors.storage.blocked: Another tab is preventing browser storage from opening. Close that tab and reload.
errors.storage.failed: Browser storage could not save the workspace. Save a project file to keep your dataset and model.
errors.storage.missing: The dataset attachment is unavailable. Reattach the source file before saving a complete project.
